formula.approx_agree: Reduce eta extremes on each side; select first representative per eta-element chunk; average representatives

declared_component_interpretations: Global ascending order before Reduce and Select; the inspected slide does not supply explicit sorting pseudocode
Odd nonempty histories only, so median is unambiguous
Complete eta-sized chunks only, with integer eta and 0 < eta/m < 1/3
Every named reference must be present exactly once; this is a synthetic numeric API and does not authenticate chain references
Positive bounded int/Fraction arithmetic with no floating-point, target conversion or integer chain-weight rounding
Container and arithmetic limits are operational research bounds, not claimed paper parameters
not_established: Kappa, mu, epoch duration and honest-majority theorem parameter mapping
Cross-chain reference validity, selection, missing-history and epoch-boundary rules
Mining procedure, target encoding, fork choice, chain work, common-prefix or ledger rules
Quantum adversary or PoN W1 resource-model security
